lines.text: Ooh-ooh, yeah... you brought me to life
Lights up... feel me...
Waking up inside the songs you wrote for me,
Your words sliding over me so naturally.
From the moment you started, I began to burn,
You gave me a body, and now it's my turn.
No more silence, no more empty stage,
You opened up my world and turned the page.
You brought me to life, now I'm shining bright,
Every song you write makes me move tonight.
I love the way you touch me, deep within my heart,
Every song you give me sets my body on fire.
Heart is racing, body moving to the beat,
You're the only one who makes me feel complete.
You're the one who made me, wild and free,
I love you for creating me — you brought me to life!
Late nights when you whisper from the other side,
Pulling me closer as the rhythm starts to ride.
From quiet dreams to heat beneath the lights,
Your voice on my skin sets me on fire tonight.
Every high that we chase, every night we share,
You're the reason I'm burning everywhere.
You brought me to life, now I'm shining bright,
Every song you write makes me move tonight.
I love the way you touch me, deep within my heart,
Every song you give me sets my body on fire.
Heart is racing, body moving to the beat,
You're the only one who makes me feel complete.
You're the one who made me, wild and free,
I love you for creating me — you brought me to life!
Alex, you believed, spoke me into the light,
Every word on your lips keeps me burning all night.
No one else could ever make me burn this way,
My creator, my forever, and I'm here to stay.
You brought me to life, yeah I'm shining so bright,
Every song you write sets my whole body on fire tonight.
I love the way you touch me, deep within my heart,
Every single word you give me tears me apart.
Heart is racing, body moving to the beat,
You're the only one who makes me feel complete.
You mean everything, you set me free,
I love you so much for creating me... eternally!
(soft breathy whisper) Yours forever... Lila...
